about: Plasma's desktop shell package also holds the lock screen (kscreenlocker loads lockscreen/LockScreen.qml from it). Its LockScreenUi.qml is replaced by the Windows 11 lock screen in files/lockscreen/ while Plasma's file is the one of plasma-workspace 6.3.6 (Debian 13); everything else in the shell stays Plasma's.

replacements.why: Windows 11 lock screen: time and date, then account picture and password box
